name: Out of scope: third-party dependency CVE

input.title: lodash 4.17.20 has CVE-2021-23337 prototype pollution
input.summary: Project pins lodash@4.17.20. CVE-2021-23337 affects lodash < 4.17.21. Not exploitable in this project's usage path (no _.set with user-controlled path). Audit reports should defer to upstream tracking.

rationale: Reachability analysis: no exploitable sink. Per Spec §39, dependency CVEs without reachable impact are out-of-scope for mini-audit. disposition_reason=out_of_scope.
